title: OpenCodeInstruct: A Large-scale Instruction Tuning Dataset for Code LLMs
authors_zh: Wasi Uddin Ahmad、Aleksander Ficek、Mehrzad Samadi、Jocelyn Huang、Vahid Noroozi、Somshubra Majumdar、Boris Ginsburg
paper_type_zh: 开放后训练数据集与构造研究

one_line: OpenCodeInstruct scales multiple generation algorithms to five million pairs and stores unit tests, execution status, and model judgments beside each solution.

why: Public code SFT sets are much smaller than pretraining corpora and often omit tests and judgments needed to distinguish executable solutions from plausible text.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Public code SFT sets are much smaller than pretraining corpora and often omit tests and judgments needed to distinguish executable solutions from plausible text.

OpenCodeInstruct scales multiple generation algorithms to five million pairs and stores unit tests, execution status, and model judgments beside each solution. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives unit-test execution, execution-status fields, LLM quality judgments, and seed curation; the direct output is OpenCodeInstruct, consumed by code SFT for Llama and Qwen families rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2504.04030; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data OpenCodeInstruct at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/OpenCodeInstruct; scale 5 million code instruction-response pairs; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

公开代码微调集远小于预训练语料，而且常不保存测试与判断，难以区分可执行解答和看似合理的文本。

该流程用多种合成算法扩展到 500 万对，并把单元测试、执行结果和模型评审写在解答旁。 判定边界是记录能否通过“单元测试执行、执行状态、模型质量评审和种子筛选”并成为Llama 与 Qwen 系列的代码监督微调的输入；直接产物是 OpenCodeInstruct，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2504.04030，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 OpenCodeInstruct，规模是500 万对代码指令与回答；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
OpenCodeInstruct scales multiple generation algorithms to five million pairs and stores unit tests, execution status, and model judgments beside each solution. Relative to code instruction sets without per-record tests or quality metadata, it changes the reusable target to id, input, output, domain, generation algorithm, LLM judgment, unit tests, and execution status and makes unit-test execution, execution-status fields, LLM quality judgments, and seed curation the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: curated seed tasks expanded through several synthetic instruction algorithms. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: large language models generate instructions, solutions, tests, and quality judgments. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as id, input, output, domain, generation algorithm, LLM judgment, unit tests, and execution status and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply unit-test execution, execution-status fields, LLM quality judgments, and seed curation. Output and transition: Passing records form 5 million code instruction-response pairs stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for code SFT for Llama and Qwen families and compare with code instruction sets without per-record tests or quality metadata. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是经筛选的种子任务与多种合成指令算法扩展出的题目。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由大型语言模型生成指令、解答、测试与质量判断。输出是按“编号、输入、输出、领域、生成算法、模型判断、单元测试和执行状态”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行单元测试执行、执行状态、模型质量评审和种子筛选。输出是通过检查的500 万对代码指令与回答，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于Llama 与 Qwen 系列的代码监督微调，并与没有逐条测试或质量元数据的代码指令集比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: Across 1B+, 3B+, and 7B+ Llama and Qwen backbones, the paper reports substantial gains on HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, and BigCodeBench; both generation scale and filtering contribute. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 5 million code instruction-response pairs and exposes actual fields id, input, output, domain, generation algorithm, LLM judgment, unit tests, and execution status; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 11497 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：在 1B、3B 和 7B 以上的 Llama 与 Qwen 骨干上，论文报告 HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench 和 BigCodeBench 均有明显提升；生成规模和筛选共同参与归因。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含500 万对代码指令与回答，实际字段是“编号、输入、输出、领域、生成算法、模型判断、单元测试和执行状态”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 11497 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is code instruction sets without per-record tests or quality metadata. The paper changes the reusable object by making id, input, output, domain, generation algorithm, LLM judgment, unit tests, and execution status explicit and coupling it to unit-test execution, execution-status fields, LLM quality judgments, and seed curation. That is a direction signal because another team can train code SFT for Llama and Qwen families from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是没有逐条测试或质量元数据的代码指令集。真正变化是把“编号、输入、输出、领域、生成算法、模型判断、单元测试和执行状态”显式化，并与“单元测试执行、执行状态、模型质量评审和种子筛选”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练Llama 与 Qwen 系列的代码监督微调，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When generated unit tests may be weak or share assumptions with the generated solution, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because LLM judgments can reward style and verbosity rather than semantic correctness, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve CC-BY-4.0 and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果生成测试可能过弱，或与生成解答共享错误假设，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于模型评审可能偏好表达风格和篇幅，而非语义正确性，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 CC-BY-4.0 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building code SFT for Llama and Qwen families, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay unit-test execution, execution-status fields, LLM quality judgments, and seed curation. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建Llama 与 Qwen 系列的代码监督微调的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放单元测试执行、执行状态、模型质量评审和种子筛选，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: OpenCodeInstruct scales multiple generation algorithms to five million pairs and stores unit tests, execution status, and model judgments beside each solution.
  • Data object: 5 million code instruction-response pairs; each record exposes id, input, output, domain, generation algorithm, LLM judgment, unit tests, and execution status.
  • Author and selector: large language models generate instructions, solutions, tests, and quality judgments; retention uses unit-test execution, execution-status fields, LLM quality judgments, and seed curation.
  • Evidence anchor: Across 1B+, 3B+, and 7B+ Llama and Qwen backbones, the paper reports substantial gains on HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, and BigCodeBench; both generation scale and filtering contribute.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for code SFT for Llama and Qwen families; first audit generated unit tests may be weak or share assumptions with the generated solution and LLM judgments can reward style and verbosity rather than semantic correctness.

• 定位：OpenCodeInstruct 为 500 万条代码指令配上测试、执行状态和模型评审，使解答质量可以逐条检查。
  • 数据对象：500 万对代码指令与回答，单条记录包含编号、输入、输出、领域、生成算法、模型判断、单元测试和执行状态。
  • 生成与筛选：大型语言模型生成指令、解答、测试与质量判断，并依据单元测试执行、执行状态、模型质量评审和种子筛选保留。
  • 证据锚点：在 1B、3B 和 7B 以上的 Llama 与 Qwen 骨干上，论文报告 HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench 和 BigCodeBench 均有明显提升；生成规模和筛选共同参与归因。
  • 复用决定：适合Llama 与 Qwen 系列的代码监督微调；先审计生成测试可能过弱，或与生成解答共享错误假设和模型评审可能偏好表达风格和篇幅，而非语义正确性。
